{{Top|leg}}
'''Crystalline Plaza''' was an area of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] that served as a public thoroughfare and was home to the [[Imeici Spire]]. The plaza contained many different types of sculptures, all made from crystal, many of which were destroyed when the massive Spire collapsed.
